svg.title: Power Wheels 24V conversion schematic
svg.desc: Blueprint side view of a ride-on vehicle with its 24-volt drive system overlaid: two 12-volt batteries in series, main fuse, PWM speed controller, thermal cutoff, emergency stop, and two drive motors.
